lines.en: Mia, there is nothing I can do about the printer, and the client expects the files by noon.

lines.en: There must be something we can try. Everything you need is in the supplies cupboard, isn’t it?
lines.pt: Deve haver algo que possamos tentar. Tudo de que você precisa está no armário de suprimentos, não é?

lines.en: Not quite. The only thing I found was an old cable, and it does not fit.
lines.pt: Não exatamente. A única coisa que achei foi um cabo velho, e ele não encaixa.

lines.en: Then let us ask IT. Anything they can send us quickly would help.
lines.pt: Então vamos pedir ao TI. Qualquer coisa que possam nos mandar rápido ajudaria.

lines.en: I already called them. All they said was that someone would come after lunch.
lines.pt: Eu já liguei. Tudo o que disseram foi que alguém viria depois do almoço.

lines.en: That is too late. Is there anything else we can do, or anyone we can borrow a printer from?

lines.en: Maybe the shop across the road. The man I talked to last week offered to help whenever we needed.
lines.pt: Talvez a loja do outro lado da rua. O homem com quem falei semana passada ofereceu ajuda sempre que precisássemos.

lines.en: Perfect. I will go there now. Everything we need to print is on that blue USB stick, right?
lines.pt: Perfeito. Vou lá agora. Tudo o que precisamos imprimir está naquele pen drive azul, certo?

lines.en: Yes, and the only document I have not saved is the invoice. Give me ten minutes.
lines.pt: Sim, e o único documento que não salvei é a fatura. Me dê dez minutos.

lines.en: Do not panic. Nothing you did is serious, and the client knows how stressful deadlines can be.
lines.pt: Não entre em pânico. Nada do que você fez é grave, e o cliente sabe como prazos podem ser estressantes.

lines.en: Thanks, Mia. Honestly, the best thing you could do for me right now is bring coffee.
lines.pt: Obrigado, Mia. Sinceramente, a melhor coisa que você poderia fazer por mim agora é trazer café.

teach.goal: Ponte português → inglês com palavras úteis.
solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.

Aluno diz em português um uso real, depois a palavra em inglês.

facts.label: Relativa sem pronome
facts.sub: There is nothing I can do. Everything we need is here. The only thing I found was a cable. Omita that.

facts.label: Nada
facts.sub: Use nothing + sujeito + verbo para dizer que não existe solução: There is nothing I can do. Em português dizemos “nada que eu possa fazer”. Em inglês, o pronome that é opcional e muito raro nessa frase.

facts.label: Algo
facts.sub: Use something + sujeito + verbo para sugerir uma possibilidade: There must be something we can try. Em perguntas, use anything: Is there anything we can do? A ordem das palavras continua normal.

items.s: Nothing I can do is natural.

Everything we need is a good phrase.

pages.title: A broken printer in Leeds · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eleven o’clock on a busy morning in Leeds. Walt stands next to a printer that does not work. The client expects the files by noon. His colleague Ana walks over quickly. Phones ring, and nobody has time. They need a clever plan, and they need it now.

“Ana, there is nothing I can do about the printer, and the client expects the files by noon.” says Walt. “There must be something we can try. Everything you need is in the supplies cupboard, isn’t it?” says Ana. “Not quite. The only thing I found was an old cable, and it does not fit.” says Walt.

paragraphs: “Do not panic. Nothing you did is serious, and the client knows how stressful deadlines can be.” says Ana. “Thanks, Ana. Honestly, the best thing you could do for me right now is bring coffee.” says Walt. Ana runs across the road with the USB stick. The shop owner smiles and starts the machine. pages.title: Encontre a frase natural

opts: There is nothing I can do.
There is nothing that I can to do.
There is nothing what I can do.
items.why: Do not use what; omit the pronoun or use that.

opts: All that what I need is coffee.
All what I need is coffee.
items.why: After all, use that or nothing, not what.

opts: Everything what we need is here.
Everything which we needs is here.
items.why: Do not use what after everything.

opts: Is there something that can we do?
Is there something we can do?
Is there something can we do?
items.why: After something, keep the normal word order: we can do.

Escolha a frase mais natural. → Everything we need is here.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → Is there something we can do?
